name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold explorer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The company is in the advanced exploration and resource definition stage, with Kinross Gold and Central Puerto as strategic investors. AbraSilver also holds an option and joint venture with Teck Resources on the La Coipita project in San Juan province.
